$comment: The operators realm, kept as code (decided 2026-11-27): the people who run the platform sign in here, apart from the members who play on it, so no operator account is a member account and no member token is accepted by an operator tool. It follows realm/members.json in everything but its clients; `npm run cli -- configure` and `check` take both realms.

${NAME} placeholders are filled from the environment of the configure run, with the defaults in `values`. Every default is a TEST-ONLY value. The realms share the relying-party ID, the mail server and the event expiries under the same names (IDP_WEBAUTHN_RP_ID, IDP_SMTP_*, IDP_EVENTS_EXPIRATION, IDP_ADMIN_EVENTS_EXPIRATION), so one deployment setting covers both: both issuers live on id.subzerodev.com and its passkeys are scoped to exactly that host. The Dashboard's redirect is IDP_DASHBOARD_REDIRECT (production: https://dashboard.subzerodev.com/auth/callback).

Enrolment and recovery are the members rulings: `npm run cli -- invite USERNAME --email ADDRESS --realm operators` creates the account and emails a link that registers a passkey and recovery codes; `reset --realm operators` removes every credential and session and sends a new link. There is no GitHub or other brokered sign-in; `check` fails on any identity provider.
Session lifetimes are D9: a 5-minute access token and a 2-hour idle, 10-hour maximum SSO session. No operators client can ask for an offline session, so the realm sets no offline lifetime.

Clients: dashboard (confidential, PKCE, standard flow only). Its secret is generated by Keycloak, is never in this file, and is read through the admin API by whoever deploys the Dashboard. The Dashboard moves to this issuer in the Supabase-exit sequence's step 6; until then nothing signs in here.

userProfile.$comment: As in members: a username and nothing else an operator can see or edit. The email attribute stays, optional and admin-only, because the invite and reset links are sent to it.

events.$comment: The same stored events as members, for the same investigations. The 30-day expiries are TEST-ONLY.

browserFlow.description: Username, then a passkey or a recovery code. A username with no usable credential is refused; no set-up page is reachable before authentication.
